base_candidate.role: frozen detector, execution semantics, leadership, portfolio arbitration and Nautilus account path

hypothesis.problem: V1 correctly measured local response but stored ACCEPTANCE or FAILURE as a permanent episode label. The only V1 core winner entered one bar after resolution; the three V1 core losses reused the label approximately 8, 13 and 27 bars later. A separate SESSION_I7 loss bypassed the router entirely.
hypothesis.causal_claim: A resolved response is an entry-enabling event only while inherited structural confirmation belongs to the same newly resolved auction leg.
hypothesis.router: Fresh FAILURE admits inherited FAR; fresh ACCEPTANCE admits inherited AAC; UNRESOLVED or STALE is no trade.
hypothesis.lifecycle: The decision is valid on its resolution bar and the immediately following completed bar, then becomes STALE. A new sweep extreme starts a new episode.
hypothesis.coverage: SESSION_I7 fails closed as UNRESOLVED because it does not expose Candidate 15's continuously observed external-liquidity response episode.
hypothesis.non_goal: V2 does not fit future return, change targets, change risk, add leverage caps or replace NautilusTrader.

router.calibration: up to 120 completed pre-sweep one-minute bars
router.impact_model: non-negative contemporaneous log-return response to signed aggressor-flow pressure weighted by square-root relative volume
channels: close occupancy beyond the latest crossed external boundary
router.sequential_rule: bounded channel mean accumulates log(2) units at full agreement; symmetric boundary log(9) is a design convention, not a calibrated posterior probability
router.reset: a new sweep extreme or crossed boundary starts a new causal episode

selection.method: D1/H1/S1 are explicitly contaminated V1 mechanism replays. U1-U5 were committed before V2 outcomes, are disjoint from V1 and Candidate 13's five published holdout weeks, span different calendar regimes, and are Candidate-15-V2-unseen but not represented as project-wide untouched data.

evaluation.interpretation: Five isolated unseen weeks are screening evidence. They cannot establish long-run success without a frozen continuous account.
